en.headline: Kwong Kau pleads guilty to preventing lawful burial in Abby Choi murder trial
en.dek: The 68-year-old former father-in-law of the slain socialite admitted the charge on Friday during the fifth week of the High Court trial; the murder allegation continues.
body: Kwong Kau pleaded guilty on Friday to preventing the lawful burial of Abby Choi’s body, as the High Court trial of the 2023 murder case entered its fifth week before a nine-member jury.

The 68-year-old retired police sergeant had previously denied the charge. His two sons, who are also standing trial for murder, had pleaded guilty to the same burial-prevention offence before the trial began. All three continue to face the murder charge relating to the death of the 28-year-old socialite on 21 February 2023 in a Tai Po village house.
The prosecution alleges the body was dismembered at a rental flat in Lung Mei. The trial on the remaining charges is continuing.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳案鄺球改認阻止合法埋葬屍體罪
zh.dek: 六十八歲前家翁周五在高等法院審訊第五周認罪，該項控罪他原先否認；謀殺控罪繼續審理。
body: 蔡天鳳被殺案的前家翁鄺球周五改認阻止合法埋葬屍體罪，高等法院審訊進入第五周，由九人陪審團聆聽。
這名六十八歲退休警長此前否認有關控罪。他的兩名兒子亦被控謀殺，並在審訊開始前已就阻止合法埋葬屍體罪認罪。三人繼續面對謀殺控罪，案情指二十八歲的蔡天鳳於二零二三年二月二十一日在大埔村屋遇害。
控方指屍體在龍尾村一出租單位被肢解。其餘控罪的審訊繼續進行。
